name: Cheesy "French Onion" Beef & Potato Skillet with Sautéed Spinach
ingredients: 6 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Wash, dry, and quarter potatoes; place in a large pot, along with salt, and cover with hot water (from the tap). Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer until fork-tender, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and slice onions crosswise into thin half-moons. Peel and mince garlic.
Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and garlic to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes.
Add beef and spices to the skillet. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the beef is cooking, coarsely grate mozzarella.

When the potatoes are done, drain and add to the skillet with the beef and onions. Gently crush some of the potatoes using a fork or potato masher. Add broth and Worcestershire to the skillet and stir to combine. (Reserve pot for later use.)
Sprinkle mozzarella over the beef and potatoes. Place skillet in the oven and bake until the mozzarella is melted and golden, 7-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the spinach. (Skip this step if it came pre-washed.)
Return the pot to medium heat.

Once the pot is hot, add additional butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Season with salt and pepper, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide beef-potato skillet and spinach between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
